column2: LAG3 is a promising target for gastric cancer patients with low prognostic nutritional index
The present study suggests that GC patients with low PNI may benefit from LAG3-targeted therapy.
We performed scRNA-seq analysis from 38 gastric cancers and 16 adjacent normal gastric mucosae.

column2: Single-cell library preparation was performed according to the manual of the Chromium Next GEM Single-cell 3' Reagent Kits v3.1 the Chromium Next GEM Single Cell 5′ Kit v2 for Dual Index (10x Genomics). The cell suspensions were loaded on the Single-cell G Chip for gel bead-in-emulsion (GEM) generation and barcoding. cDNA library thus was generated with a droplet-based sequencing platform (10X Genomics). Next, reverse transcription, RT cleanup cDNA amplification, and quantification was performed to construct the 3’ and 5’ gene library.
The libraries were sequenced on NovaSeq6000 (Illumina) or DNBSEQ-G400 (MGI Tech).
Raw sequencing reads were aligned to the human reference genome GRCh38 and processed to a matrix representing the UMI’s per cell barcode per gene using Cell Ranger v7.1.0 (10x Genomics)
Output files were analyzed with the R v4.2.1 package "Seurat v4.3.0".
To merge the data of all samples, we used the "SCTransform" package for the normalization and variance stabilization of molecular count data.
